items.exampleEn: The bridge was made of large logs.
items.exampleZh: 那座橋是用大圓木搭成的。

items.exampleEn: The curtains in my room are dark blue.
items.exampleZh: 我房間的窗簾是深藍色的。

items.exampleEn: Old cars end up at the dump.
items.exampleZh: 舊車最後都會被送到垃圾場。

items.exampleEn: Be careful not to drop the needle on the floor.
The cat likes to sleep on the carpet.
items.exampleZh: 這隻貓喜歡睡在地毯上。
以前的火車是靠蒸汽開動的。

items.exampleEn: I can't open this jar of honey.

items.sentenceEn: Open the curtains and let the sunshine in.
items.sentenceZh: 打開窗簾，讓陽光照進來。

items.audioEn: The steam from the kettle set off the fire alarm.
items.audioZh: 水壺冒出的蒸汽讓火災警報器響了。
items.questionZh: 是什麼讓火災警報器響了？

items.sentenceEn: My grandmother keeps her buttons in an old glass jar.
items.sentenceZh: 我奶奶把鈕扣放在一個舊玻璃罐裡。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't dump your old furniture on the street.
items.sentenceZh: 請不要把舊家具丟在街上。

items.stemEn: I need a ____ to sew this button back on.
items.stemZh: 我需要一根針把這顆鈕扣縫回去。

items.stemEn: The power went out, so we lit a ____.
items.stemZh: 停電了，所以我們點了一根蠟燭。

items.passageEn: Every winter, my family stays in a mountain cabin for a week. Each evening, my father carries logs inside and builds a fire. The old carpet in front of the fire is soft and warm. We drink hot tea and watch the steam rise from our cups. My mother lights candles on the table, and my sister knits a pullover with long needles. In the morning, we have bread with jam from a big glass jar. It is a simple life, but we love it.
items.passageZh: 每年冬天，我們全家都會在山上的小木屋住一個星期。每天傍晚，爸爸把木柴搬進屋裡生火。火爐前的舊地毯又軟又暖和。我們喝熱茶，看著杯子冒出熱氣。媽媽在桌上點起蠟燭，妹妹用長棒針織一件套頭毛衣。早上，我們從一個大玻璃罐裡挖果醬配麵包吃。生活很簡單，但我們很喜歡。

items.promptZh: 我們客廳鋪了一塊新地毯。
referenceEn: We put a new carpet in our living room.
There is a new carpet in our living room.
rubricZh: carpet 表示「地毯」，是可數名詞
時態配合內容（例如 put、is）

items.instructionZh: 用 candle 造一個句子，說說你什麼時候會點蠟燭。
referenceEn: I light candles when I take a bath.
I light candles on my friends' birthday cakes.
rubricZh: 「點蠟燭」可寫，例如 light a candle、light candles 等
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
